# Google AI & Vertex AI Gemini API Dart Client

> Dart client for the Google AI Gemini Developer API and Vertex AI Gemini API with stable Developer API Interactions, text generation, image generation, tool calling, grounding tools, Live API WebSockets and Genie 4 WebSocket and WebRTC sessions, service tier routing, and embeddings.

Note: Google lists several Vertex AI products and features (e.g. Vertex AI Platform, Generative AI on Vertex AI) under the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform brand; the API and SDKs still use the Vertex AI name, which this client keeps. See the [Vertex AI name changes](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/vertex-ai-name-changes) page.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/README.md) (~4.9k tokens): Primary package documentation with installation, configuration, and usage examples.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/CHANGELOG.md) (~8.9k tokens): Release history and version-by-version changes.
- [MIGRATION](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/MIGRATION.md) (~5.3k tokens): Upgrade notes and breaking-change guidance.

## Examples

- [example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/example.dart) (~326 tokens): Stable Developer API Interactions quickstart.
- [interactions_media_slicing.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/interactions_media_slicing.dart): Process selected Interactions document pages and layers.
- [interactions_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/interactions_example.dart) (~1.2k tokens): Stable Interactions, streaming, state and function calls.
- [interactions_long_decode.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/interactions_long_decode.dart): Opt-in automatic continuation for foreground Gemini 4 interactions.
- [agents_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/agents_example.dart): Create and reuse a managed agent on Gemini Developer API v1beta.
- [triggers_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/triggers_example.dart): Schedule managed-agent interactions, run a trigger, and inspect executions.
- [webhooks_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/webhooks_example.dart): Subscribe to Gemini webhook events and verify static signatures.
- [generate_content.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/generate_content.dart) (~194 tokens): Basic text generation.
- [generate_content_media_slicing.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/generate_content_media_slicing.dart): GenerateContent PDF page selection.
- [streaming_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/streaming_example.dart) (~224 tokens): Streaming responses.
- [image_generation_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/image_generation_example.dart) (~1.2k tokens): Image generation.
- [tts_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/tts_example.dart) (~1.3k tokens): Text-to-speech with Gemini TTS models.
- [function_calling_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/function_calling_example.dart) (~578 tokens): Tool calling.
- [tool_retrieval_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/tool_retrieval_example.dart): Preview tool retrieval with Gemini Developer API `v1beta`.
- [google_search_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/google_search_example.dart) (~1k tokens): Grounding with Google Search.
- [embeddings_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/embeddings_example.dart) (~490 tokens): Text embeddings.
- [files_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/files_example.dart) (~1.5k tokens): File uploads for prompts.
- [environment_config_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/environment_config_example.dart): Configure or fork a hosted managed environment on the Gemini Developer API v1beta.
- [environment_files_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/environment_files_example.dart): List and download managed environment workspace files on the Gemini Developer API v1beta.
- [genie_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/genie_example.dart): Genie 4 creation, live JPEG frames, and completion.
- [register_cloud_storage_files.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/register_cloud_storage_files.dart): Register Cloud Storage files with Gemini Files and OAuth.
- [genie_webrtc_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/genie_webrtc_example.dart): Browser WebRTC signaling and native media playback for Genie 4.
- [live_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/live_example.dart) (~1.2k tokens): Live API WebSocket sessions.
- [live_music_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/live_music_example.dart): Experimental Lyria RealTime music over Gemini Developer API v1beta and raw PCM output.
- [live_transcription_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/live_transcription_example.dart) (~590 tokens): Gemini Live Transcribe with PCM audio, interim captions, and finalized text.
- [error_handling_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/error_handling_example.dart) (~644 tokens): Exception handling patterns.
- [abort_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/abort_example.dart) (~626 tokens): Request cancellation with abort triggers.
- [api_versions_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/googleai_dart/example/api_versions_example.dart) (~1.1k tokens): API version selection (v1 vs v1beta).
